paper.title: AutoML-Zero: Evolving Machine Learning Algorithms From Scratch
paper.central_claim: AutoML-Zero：仅用基本数学运算作构件，用正则化进化从空程序搜索完整 ML 算法（Setup/Predict/Learn）；进化能重新发现带反向传播的两层网络，在 CIFAR-10 变体上进化出超过调参 2 层 NN 的算法（双线性、归一化梯度、权重平均），并随任务类型出现类 dropout、学习率衰减等适配。
paper.scope_note: 搜索框架 + 发现的算法；范围边界：非 LLM 的程序进化(2020)，产出是 ML 学习算法而非 agent 外壳，作者明确放弃自指要求。

provenance.notes: actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref null: subagent dispatched via claude-kimi model type; no run receipt exposed to the worker (not probed). Score arithmetic: coverage is a 0..1 fraction; lower/upper are 0..100.

sections_read: Supplement S1–S10(含 S3/S5/S7/S8/S9/S10；S6 原始代码仅略读)
missing_sections: S6 原始进化代码仅略读

evidence.quote: Our goal is to show that AutoML can go further: it is possible today to automatically discover complete machine learning algorithms just using basic mathematical operations as building blocks.
evidence.support_explanation: 中心主张：用基本数学运算自动发现完整 ML 算法。

evidence.quote: human-designed components bias the search results in favor of human-designed algorithms, possibly reducing the innovation potential of AutoML
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap：专家设计的构件使搜索偏向人类算法。

evidence.quote: the space is so generic that it ends up being quite sparse.
evidence.support_explanation: 搜索空间极稀疏，随机搜索不足。

evidence.quote: To avoid biasing the choice of ops, we use a simple criterion: those that are typically learned by high-school level.
evidence.support_explanation: 算子仅取高中水平运算，刻意排除 ML 概念与导数。

evidence.quote: This parent is then copied and mutated to produce a child algorithm that is added to the population, while the oldest algorithm in the population is removed.
evidence.support_explanation: 正则化进化：复制-变异-加入种群，淘汰最老者（留存规则）。

evidence.quote: (i) insert a random instruction or remove an instruction at a random location in a component function, (ii) randomize all the instructions in a component function, or (iii) modify one of the arguments of an instruction by replacing it with a random choice
evidence.support_explanation: 三类随机变异，无评价信号引导（非接地变异）。

evidence.quote: (FEC) that detects equivalent supervised ML algorithms, even if they have different implementations, achieving a 4x speedup.
evidence.support_explanation: 功能等价检查，4× 加速。

evidence.quote: we consistently save 75 % 75\% of our compute
evidence.support_explanation: hurdles 以滚动 75 分位早停，稳定节省 75% 算力。

evidence.quote: Even in the simple case of linear regression, we find that evolution is 5 times more efficient than RS.
evidence.support_explanation: 等评估数下进化比随机搜索效率高 5×（线性回归）。

evidence.quote: As soon as we advance to nonlinear data, the gap widens and we can no longer find solutions with RS.
evidence.support_explanation: 非线性数据上随机搜索找不到解。

evidence.quote: We restrict the search space by only using necessary ops and fixing component function lengths to those of known solutions.
evidence.support_explanation: §4.1 的结果在人为收窄的空间（仅必要算子、固定长度）下取得。

evidence.quote: evolution not only discovers the forward pass, but also “invents” back-propagation code to learn the weights
evidence.support_explanation: D=100 个任务时进化重新发现含反向传播的两层网络。

evidence.quote: The candidate algorithms perform better in 13 out of 20 experiments.
evidence.support_explanation: 20 次独立搜索中 13 次在 T_select 上优于 2 层 NN（失败分母）。

evidence.quote: Evaluating with 5 different random seeds, the best evolved algorithm’s accuracy
For comparison, we tune two hand-designed baselines, one linear and one nonlinear, using the same total compute that went into discovering and tuning the evolved algorithm.
evidence.support_explanation: 两个手工基线用与发现+调参相同总算力调参（口径含糊）。

evidence.quote: This algorithm is limited by our simple search space, which cannot currently represent some techniques that are crucial in state-of-the-art models, like batch normalization or convolution.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认搜索空间不能表示批归一化、卷积；基线是同样简化的网络。

evidence.quote: We stress that the CIFAR-10 test set was used only in this final evaluation
evidence.support_explanation: 测试集仅用于最终评估，不参与 T_search 与 T_select。

evidence.quote: we treat all the constants in the algorithms as hyperparameters and jointly tune them using random search.
evidence.support_explanation: 迁移到 3072 维时对常数做随机搜索调参。

evidence.quote: This required time-consuming analysis that could be automated by future work.
evidence.support_explanation: 超参数耦合需要人工识别并解耦（自动化留作未来工作）。

evidence.quote: 4 out of the 6 ablations caused a large drop in accuracy.
evidence.support_explanation: 敲除消融：6 个代码段中 4 个导致显著下降。

evidence.quote: The remaining 2 code sections show no significant loss upon ablation, and so were removed for code readability.
evidence.support_explanation: 另 2 段无显著影响，被删去。

evidence.quote: We find that the noisy ReLU is reproducible and arises preferentially in the case of little data
evidence.support_explanation: 少样本下噪声 ReLU 在 8/30 次重复出现，对照 0/30。

evidence.quote: While we do not know the reason, the preference is statistically significant
evidence.support_explanation: 多分类下“权重均值作学习率”24/30 vs 对照 0/30，但原因未知。

evidence.quote: With overwhelming confidence, the decay appears much more often in the cases with fewer training steps
evidence.support_explanation: 学习率衰减 30/30 vs 对照 3/30。

evidence.quote: Altogether, these experiments show that the resulting algorithms seem to adapt well to the different types of tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者结论（措辞谨慎）。

evidence.quote: Each experiment setup was run 100 times.
evidence.support_explanation: 基线实验在三个算力级别各重复 100 次。

evidence.quote: We find that all four upgrades are beneficial across the three different compute scales tested.
evidence.support_explanation: 搜索方法四项升级在三种规模下均有益（每行 30 次）。

evidence.quote: was not the focus of this study but to reach our results, it helped to
evidence.support_explanation: 作者称搜索方法非重点。

evidence.quote: population and runs on a commodity CPU core.
evidence.support_explanation: 每个进程在一个商用 CPU 核上运行（共 W=10k 进程，约 5 天，作者在 S5 给出）。

evidence.quote: We then run the evolution experiments with the same combined total number of evaluations as for RS.
evidence.support_explanation: 进化与随机搜索等评估数对比。

evidence.quote: but focus on common machine learning tasks and have dropped the self-reflexivity requirement.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者明确放弃自指（自我改进）要求：不是自我改进闭环。

evidence.quote: also search for a symbolic optimizer, but in a restricted search space of hand-tuned operations
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻 Bello 2017：受限的符号优化器搜索。

evidence.quote: We use all the tasks from 36 of the pairs to form the
evidence.support_explanation: 36 个类对用于 T_search，其余 9 对用于 T_select（类对级划分）。

evidence.quote: we finally run the tuned algorithms on 2000 examples from the held-out CIFAR-10 test set
evidence.support_explanation: 最终仅 2000 个留出测试样本。

evidence.quote: This gain also generalizes to binary classification tasks extracted from other datasets: SVHN
evidence.support_explanation: 增益迁移到 SVHN、ImageNet(降采样)、Fashion MNIST。

evidence.quote: In particular, there are no derivatives so any gradient computation used for training must be evolved.
evidence.support_explanation: 搜索空间不含导数，梯度必须被进化出来。

evidence.quote: Preliminary implementations of crossover and geographic structure did not help in our experiments.
evidence.support_explanation: 交叉与地理结构的初步实现无效（负面结果被报告）。

evidence.quote: None of the meta-parameters were tuned in the final set of experiments at full compute scale.
evidence.support_explanation: 最终全规模实验未调元参数。

evidence.quote: Run time: 5 5 days.
evidence.support_explanation: 每个实验约 5 天。

signatures.object: 搜索方法自身（FEC、hurdles、迁移、MNIST 多样性）

signatures.output: 更高吞吐与更好最终算法
signatures.claimed_effect: 四项升级均有益（S9 表）

gap.author_gap: AutoML 的搜索空间依赖专家设计的构件，偏向人类算法且需要精心构造，削弱了创新潜力与省力初衷。
gap.checked_gap: 真实且来源充足（NAS、受限符号优化器、学习优化器）；最近邻的残余明确：它们固定了模型结构/反传，本文把结构与学习规则都变成搜索变量。“减少人类偏置”属信念，尚无证明偏置是瓶颈；该对象是 ML 算法而非 agent 外壳。
gap.lineage: 祖先：遗传编程(Koza)、Bengio 1994 符号学习规则、神经进化；最近邻：Zoph&Le NAS、Real 2017/2019 正则化进化、Andrychowicz 学习优化器、Bello 2017、Mei 2020；程序合成：Lenat/Schmidhuber 自改进程序。版本为论文自述，本地无固定副本。

claims.text: 进化在极稀疏空间中远胜随机搜索，并能重新发现含反传的两层网络
claims.setting: §4.1：线性/仿射/教师网络回归，人为收窄的空间
claims.selection_vs_test: D 个搜索任务；教师真值可验证
claims.result_denominator: 成功率密度；每图 3 任务×10k–100k 评估；重复至统计显著
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在收窄空间里进化显著优于随机搜索并复现反传；不能外推到无约束空间。

claims.text: 由零开始（58 个算子）进化出的算法在留出 CIFAR-10 测试上超过 2 层 NN，并迁移到其它数据集
claims.setting: 投影二分类 CIFAR-10/MNIST 代理任务→3072 维 CIFAR-10
claims.baseline_control: 线性与 2 层 NN，同总算力调参
claims.selection_vs_test: T_search(36 类对) / T_select(9 类对) / 保留的 CIFAR-10 测试集
claims.result_denominator: 20 次搜索实验中 13 次优于 NN；最终 5 种子
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在所测二分类视觉任务上，进化出的简单算法稍优于调参的基线（+1.84pp）；非全自动（人工解耦），空间有限。

claims.text: 进化会根据任务类型适配算法（少数据→噪声/类 dropout，快速训练→学习率衰减）
claims.setting: §4.3：三种任务类型，种群从两层 NN 初始化
claims.selection_vs_test: 不涉及测试集，统计 motif 出现频次
claims.allowed_conclusion: 适配现象在统计上显著；motif 判定与归因为人工分析，部分机理未知。

claims.text: FEC、hurdles、迁移与 MNIST 多样性均改进搜索
claims.setting: S9 简化设定，3 个算力级别，每行 30 次
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在该简化设定下改进成立。

assessment.evidence_level_note: 进化选出的算法（留存程序）在独立选择任务、保留测试集与其它数据集上优于调参基线（作者报告；用于评分，不是我们复现）；无 improver 层证据，且搜索本身不自我改进。
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: 在人为设定的简单二分类视觉代理任务上，进化可从空程序发现比调参 2 层 NN 稍好的算法，并在任务类型改变时出现适配；“全自动发现 ML 算法”需附带人工解耦与受限空间的前提。

G.reason: 非权重对象（完整学习算法）与近邻清晰；残余缺口有界，但“偏置是瓶颈”未证，且对象不是 agent 外壳。

M.reason: 空间、变异、选择、淘汰与加速组件可重建，并提出可区分预测（密度越低进化越优、各升级逐项消融）。

X.reason: 算子集、变异、种群规模、迁移、早停、选择协议、调参与人工解耦步骤均清楚披露，边界(不能表示BN/卷积)说明明确。

E.measurement.reason: 真值准确率、独立 T_select 与保留测试集、5 种子；测试仅 2000 例，基线较弱(无动量/正则化)，类对不明。

E.causality.reason: 有随机搜索对照、四项升级消融、6 段敲除+敲入验证、30 次对照；人工筛选 motif 与手工解耦、基线较简。

E.holdout.reason: T_search/T_select/测试三层并迁移到三个其它数据集；仅图像二分类，迁移前需人工解耦并重调。

E.statistics.reason: 最终比较 5 种子±、13/20 成功分母、30/100 次重复与对照及 p 值、逐行消融 30 次。

E.cost.reason: 同评估数的 RS 对比、FEC/hurdles 节省、运行时长与核类型有；基线算力“同总算力”口径含糊，总核时未汇总。

status_reason: 全文含补充材料已读；范围为边界案例：评分采用 reviewed，范围判定留给总控/Opus。
rationale: 方法与统计严谨（含失败分母、随机搜索与消融），算法与 H14 近似，但属非 LLM、非 agent 外壳的 AutoML；范围为边界，建议复核。

scope_assessment.reason: 满足“基于执行反馈修改非权重组件(程序)并留存”的操作形式；但无自我改进闭环(作者放弃自指)、产物是 ML 学习算法、变异非 LLM、训练的是被评测的小模型权重。
scope_assessment.if_excluded: 若总控判定范围外，应改为 out_of_scope 且 score=null；本记录的八项评分不应进入排名。
